cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You ended your message with 'take care.' That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're at the final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

mechanism: A claims authority to classify every kindness as another stage of an inevitable breakup.
confusable: Unlike merely fearing abandonment, A rules on B's explanations and permits help only within the breakup interpretation.
comparison: Illness care and a soup container differ from rescheduled lunch as a supposedly public breakup.
seedUse: Use take-care message, cold and soup sequence; make S01 decide the meaning and acceptable delivery of B's reassurance.
